item.title: FEATURE: Gordon’s Reed honored to earn NFHS national track award
item.description: Mike Reed didn’t get into coaching to win awards. item.description: ROSCOE — Entering Friday’s matchup with Bangs just a game up on the Dragons for the District 8-2A lead, the 18th-ranked Roscoe boys basketball team all but settled the league’s championship race, blasting BHS 71-33 at home to take a two-game lead with four more to play.
